Based on the evidence provided, Jupiter is the largest planet in our solar system, with a diameter of about 139,820 kilometers (86,881 miles). It is predominantly composed of hydrogen and helium and has at least 79 moons, including the four large Galilean moons discovered by Galileo Galilei in 1610.

Regarding your question about the largest bone in the human body, the provided text does not contain this information. However, based on general anatomical knowledge, the largest bone in the human body is the femur (thigh bone).
